Since they've been together all their lives, they thought it would be easy to be a fake couple, but there is no way that these childhood friends, who have such great chemistry with each other, can end up being just fake lovers... (Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

synopsis: Shoujo Bousou Densetsu Fair is a manga where the author tells us the story of a real group of Bôsôzoku (biker clans) made up only of girls. So we will follow their hectic daily lives and see what problems they will have to face. The story focuses on two 14-year-old childhood friends: Madokawa Nagasawa and Miho Asakawa.
